summary: The school district emphasizes the critical role of E-Rate funding in providing essential broadband infrastructure for rural students, highlighting its importance in ensuring equitable access to digital education and resources.

claims.argument: E-Rate funding is not merely a supplementary financial resource; it is the fundamental lifeline that bridges the digital divide and guarantees students equitable access to a 21st-century education.
claims.evidence_quote: For our rural school district, E-Rate funding is not merely a supplementary financial resource; it is the fundamental lifeline that bridges the vast digital divide and guarantees our students equitable access to a 21st-century education.

filer_raw: Kendra Cupps | Grand County School District
